is_anopheles.evidence: Adult Anopheles spp. mosquitoes (An. arabiensis, An. gambiae, An. rufipes, An. pharoensis, An. funestus) were collected using pyrethrum spray catch (Page 1, Abstract; Page 5, Table 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Assessed Vgsc L1014F (kdr-w / L995F), Vgsc L1014S (kdr-e / L995S) and Ace-1 G119S (G280S) by PCR assays (Page 4, Methods; Page 5-6, Table 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 on Page 6 reports counts and percentages of L1014 wild-type, L1014F, and L1014S for An. gambiae s.l. from Nouakchott (N=145) and Hodh Elgharbi (N=40).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from indoor resting sites in five locations across Nouakchott and Hodh Elgharbi region in Mauritania between January 2009 and December 2010 (Page 2-3, Study areas).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research study presenting original field collection and laboratory analysis data.

sub_country_location.evidence: Collections took place at sub-country districts: Teyarett, Dar Naim, Sebkha (Nouakchott), and Kobeni, Tintane (Hodh Elgharbi) with GPS coordinates provided (Page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito collections were conducted between January 2009 and December 2010 (Page 3, Mosquito sampling).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study presents novel field sample collections and genotype analyses conducted directly by the authors.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype frequency data by site are fully reported in Table 3 of the main article.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated mosquito species diversity, host-feeding patterns, sporozoite rates, and insecticide resistance marker frequencies (Vgsc L1014F, L1014S, Ace-1 G119S) in Anopheles gambiae s.l. collected from Nouakchott and Hodh Elgharbi, Mauritania in 2009-2010. High frequency of L1014S was observed in An. arabiensis from Nouakchott, while both L1014F and L1014S were detected at low frequencies in Hodh Elgharbi.
